cortisol-intensity-threshold.label: Intensity at which 30 min of exercise clearly raises blood cortisol
cortisol-intensity-threshold.value: about 60% VO₂max (no rise at 40%, about +40% at 60%, about +83% at 80%)

ea-lh-threshold.label: Energy availability below which LH pulses were disrupted in women
ea-lh-threshold.value: about 125 kJ (30 kcal) per kg lean mass per day
